reason: This plugin is primarily a web-search integration for DSH, as it adds Tavily as an alternative search provider, exposes a settings toggle for official DeepSeek vs. Tavily, and documents optional credential usage for Tavily access; evidence is explicitly in the README and package metadata.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH 网页搜索添加 Tavily 提供商，并提供设置开关以在官方 DeepSeek 与 Tavily 之间切换检索来源。
summaries.en: This plugin adds Tavily as a web search provider for DSH, letting users switch the web search source between the official DeepSeek option and Tavily.

capabilities: performs web search requests via an external provider
reads optional Tavily API key from DSH credentials
adds a toggleable web-search provider option in the DSH web client
